answer: Stake bonds at the gate: a miner posts collateral C ≥ 100× expected epoch reward, so n identities lock nC capital. Slashing burns 50% of bond on any equivocation proof, making fake identities unprofitable once farm size exceeds ~3. Honest miners wander freely; attackers cannot. The yarrow test — yield per identity — collapses below zero fast. Each forged key deepens the canyon between revenue (linear) and locked cost (linear but fatal). Works because every extra identity raises capital at risk faster than it raises expected payout.
